def predict_exact_ownership(grid_shape, markers, max_d_list):
    """

    """
    output = np.zeros(grid_shape, dtype=int)
    if len(markers) > len(max_d_list):

            for i, (r0, c0) in enumerate(markers):
                d = abs(r - r0) + abs(c - c0)
                if 1 <= d <= max_d_list[i]:
                    # Check if closer to this marker than any other

                    for j, (r1, c1) in enumerate(markers):
                        if i != j:

                    if is_closer:
                        output[r, c] = 5
    
    for r0, c0 in markers:
